requirements.observation: All declared contract fields are represented. Results are rejected as unknown fields. Explicit empty contract non-goals/deliverables and check argv parse; all field omissions/nulls refuse.

requirements.requirement: Material statement/check/threshold/ceiling changes alter digest; parser must not silently discard or reinterpret document bytes; malformed documents fail closed.
requirements.observation: Strict UTF-8, surrogate, unique/case-exact key, unknown-field, trailing-document and presence checks reject malformed/ambiguous input before a digest. Valid scalar text and surrogate pair controls pass. Canonical digest follows semantic content.

requirements.requirement: Optional acceptance_contract_digest preserves legacy serialization when absent; initial criteria->planning requires binding when contract presented; every later approval carries exact accepted digest; missing/mismatched/swapped contracts refuse; changed criteria need human rewind.
requirements.observation: Real Apply refuses presented-unbound, missing, wrong-run and mismatched documents. Later digest omission/change refuses. Human rewind and new contract acceptance work. Empty additive field preserves exact legacy approval bytes.

requirements.requirement: Current core criterion IDs exactly equal contract IDs; duplicates/missing/extra IDs refuse; dispositions remain core records.

requirements.requirement: Canonical hma.plan/v1 contains all required bounded unit declarations, max_wall_minutes, cost ceiling and policy_digest; validates unit identity, references and acyclic prior-unit dependencies; digest bound by accepted_plan_digest.
requirements.observation: Every plan/unit/budget/check field omission and null rejects in ParsePlan and derivation, including missing/null max_retries. Explicit zero retries and [] argv/dependencies pass. Unknown/self/cyclic dependencies refuse.

requirements.requirement: Only latest approved legal route-selection->implementation-authorization or independent-validation->implementation-authorization transition issues lease; no issuer before approval; core unit must currently project implementation authorization; illegal review->authorization stays forbidden.
requirements.observation: Legal issuer, no-issuer, unapproved/foreign-unit/illegal-issuer and progression/correction controls pass. A whole-run Grounding rewind tagged with an unrelated unit still leaves the old lease active (F-D12R3-01).

requirements.requirement: Presented valid plan required; unit must exist; issuer plan digest and contract match current approval/core state; legacy/missing plan cannot issue; cached lease grants nothing.
requirements.observation: Malformed/absent/changed plan, absent/changed/unbound contract, wrong run and unknown unit fail closed. Core-only pure API has no host lease authority input.

requirements.requirement: Grant uses exact approved implementer route and permission, within contract ceilings; current effective policy digest equals plan policy_digest; conflicts refuse.

Changed approved route identity changes accepted plan digest and rejects the preserved old plan. Effective policy drift/absence refuses.

requirements.requirement: Later approved rewind of unit/run/transitive dependency voids old lease; unrelated rewind does not void; only a new legal issuance can resume; no revival of old generation.

requirements.requirement: Wall-time interval is [human approval, approval+max_wall_minutes); unit counters nonnegative and strictly below effective ceilings; terminal runs refuse.
requirements.observation: Human approval timestamp governs [issued, expiry); one nanosecond before expiry passes, exact expiry/preapproval refuse. Real Apply of two-minute-old approval yields expired one-minute lease. All terminal outcomes and negative/equal/above ceiling counters refuse.

requirements.requirement: Lease identity deterministically digests approval transition digest, unit and accepted plan digest; each identity field matters.
requirements.observation: Reference JSON envelope using Approval.TransitionDigest/unit_id/plan_digest matches SHA-256 exactly. Each field changes identity; record anchor alone does not. Repeated derivation is deterministic and does not mutate input.

requirements.requirement: Preserve human-only transitions, exact approval binding, existing Gate B/Gate C and legacy behavior; no claims that D3-D6 host enforcement/reservation/credit/findings work is delivered.
requirements.observation: Full current repository go test, go vet and race suites pass, including existing Gate B/C tests. Legacy approval serialization matches the pre-field struct. Changed code expressly defers reservation-derived counters to D3; post-freeze handoff explicitly defers D3-D6 and does not claim full Gate D completion.

findings.title: A unit tag can hide a whole-run Grounding rewind from lease invalidation
findings.diagnosis: Real transition.Apply accepts IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZATION -> GROUNDING with UnitID D and exact fresh human approval. D exists in the approved plan and is unrelated to A. Store.Load verifies the persisted chain; ProjectStageState reports GROUNDING. DeriveLease for A returns ReasonNone and the old lease digest. Empty-unit and A-unit controls return LEASE_VOID_AFTER_REWIND. This violates the whole-run Grounding invalidation and active-stage conditions. The lease scan switches on unit scope before considering the target gate, so a non-dependent unit masks a global rewind. No forged record, host lease record, malicious model, counter reset or changed plan is needed.

evidence.observation: Later transitions are examined only for the current unit, an empty unit, or a transitive dependency; unrelated-unit GROUNDING has no branch.
A valid fresh human-approved edge to Grounding is accepted with an unrelated UnitID. Scope is not rejected before append.
Test fails because lease stays active with projected=GROUNDING and reason=""; empty/A controls refuse correctly.
Grounding changes invalidate downstream packets; existing deterministic invalidation table assigns Grounding to ScopeWholeRun and refuses narrowing a whole-run trigger to one unit.

fix.action: In DeriveLease, classify any later approved target GROUNDING or ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA as a whole-run rewind before filtering by UnitID or dependency membership. Preserve invalidation through subsequent transitions until a new legal issuer. At the transition boundary, also reject a nonempty UnitID when the transition represents a whole-run grounding/criteria rewind, using the existing whole-run scope rule. Keep Planning and Route selection invalidation scoped according to the approved plan graph.
fix.why: A run-wide gate cannot be narrowed by a unit label. Checking target semantics first prevents a current or persisted scoped record from keeping stale authority.

verification.method: Run TestAuditorD12WholeRunRewindWithUnitID for empty, A and unrelated D, in normal and race modes.
verification.expected: Each case either refuses the invalid scope before append or returns a non-active A lease after an accepted Grounding rewind.

verification.method: Add the equivalent legal Release-and-closure -> Acceptance-criteria case; progress after a global rewind without issuing a new A approval; then issue a fresh legal A approval.
verification.expected: All old A generations remain void; only the new issuer can resume.

verification.method: Run existing and auditor dependency correction/route/plan rewind controls and unrelated correction control.
verification.expected: Direct/transitive dependents refuse; independent unit remains active for genuinely unit-scoped rewinds.

verification.method: Run full go test ./..., go vet ./... and go test -race ./..., then obtain a fresh isolated audit.
verification.expected: All checks pass and the independent auditor finds no remaining rewind bypass.

fix.tradeoffs: Rejecting a scoped whole-run input may require host callers to submit a new exact human approval with empty UnitID. The lease-side guard should still refuse already persisted scoped global rewinds. Do not void independent units for every unit-scoped Planning/Route change.
fix.alternative: Reject scoped global rewinds at Apply and enforce a validated-chain invariant at every derivation boundary. This has more coupling and leaves old persisted records requiring explicit treatment. A global CurrentStage-only check is conservative but could incorrectly disable independent per-unit work, so it is not preferred.

findings.priority: P1; hold D1+D2 gate, apply minimal scope fix, rerun controls and obtain fresh isolated review.
